experiment.selection: Choose family/architecture by validation joint NLL before interpreting test; rerun selected config at seed29; report all development models without selecting on test
experiment.primary_target: fixed crossing E/D; risk grid never changes target
experiment.feature_clock: 5s decisions from latest published 1s values; 64 tokens, TCN RF61 = 300s detailed history
experiment.day_context: current and previous London compressed summaries, M1 spectra; exact new-session trade-VWAP not materialized
experiment.historical_exposure: New relative to February scientific-v1. Some dates used by historical repository experiments; not never-inspected holdout

actual_context_history.formula: min(RF, supplied_window, root_index-segment_start+1) real tokens; (tokens-1)*cadence elapsed seconds
actual_context_history.reset_definition: date, cadence gap, current/previous X unavailable, or support token change; unknown Y never resets
actual_context_history.interpretation: Consecutive real sequence history is not total information horizon: current-token rolling features, BB geometry and rich-only London summaries may summarize older observations

upstream_statistical_context_audit.definition: Reproduce FeatureStore.segment_starts exactly on every origin before filtering known Y: reset on date/cadence gap, segment-token change, or unavailable current/previous X. Real tokens=i-start+1; actual TCN tokens=min(real,supplied64,RF61); elapsed=(actual_tokens-1)*5s. Unknown labels do not reset history.
upstream_statistical_context_audit.reset_counts_caution: Cause counts overlap. Token changes combine source capture/epoch/1s gap/admission and quote epoch/invalid/60s gap; these are not automatically physical quote support failures.
source_code_findings: features.asof_source starts a source segment after any endpoint step !=1s, capture/epoch change, or inadmissible source row (including recovery).
full_history.generate_features admission additionally requires available_ns-t_ns<=1s, even if the canonical second's book is valid.

finalize_market._second_rows creates one-second rows and publishes them at max(endpoint,next raw receive time); an ordinary quiet interval can therefore produce late rows and an admission-driven sequence reset without proving a quote support loss.

This is a conservative representation boundary. Five minutes is the maximum receptive field, not the typical supplied detailed context. No frozen features, segments, runs or fits are changed by this audit.

bounded_source_witness.conclusion: This exact source-admission reset happens while the bounded canonical quote slice remains supported: a valid second published 1.215s late becomes inadmissible under the source 1s publication-delay rule. It demonstrates conservative fragmentation, not a physical quote support break.
bounded_source_witness.generalization_limit: One verified witness; the share of all resets attributable to this mechanism was not measured. Do not describe it as the dominant cause without a full attribution audit.
